reflection_capture_mapping.node_purpose: Map four preserved R1 reflection drafts into the shared strict model-owned reflection surface without changing research judgment.
reflection_capture_mapping.input_scale: Each input is one complete R1 tool draft plus its exact role-specific schema, reference enums and control constraints.
reflection_capture_mapping.required_outputs: One syntactically valid reflection submission preserving all existing research conclusions and authorized references.
reflection_capture_mapping.schema_burden: Nested answered questions, graph hypotheses, next-request control and compact predicate constraints require full contract visibility.
reflection_capture_mapping.materiality_quality_risk: A mapping error can drop a material gap, invent a reference or change a stop proposal, so truncation must fail closed.
reflection_capture_mapping.comparable_run_evidence: R1 produced four complete but contract-invalid reflection drafts between 2181 and 7001 characters with HTTP 200 tool calls.
reflection_capture_mapping.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because this node maps a preserved judgment and must not perform new research.
reflection_capture_mapping.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one tool call, no retry; length, missing call, reference drift or invalid control state consumes the attempt and fails closed.

supply_followup_reflection_analysis.node_purpose: Analyze the one newly executed Dell subject relationship request and decide how it changes the Supply specialist judgment.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.input_scale: One new current S1/S2 response, its FeedbackReceipts, the prior Supply reflection and the bounded three-request catalog.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.required_outputs: A substantive second-round reflection covering support, remaining gaps, mechanism, counterevidence and a justified stop proposal.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.schema_burden: The draft must preserve current Evidence and gap refs while separating compact graph predicates from explanatory research use.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: This is the only uncovered Supply proposition; under-analysis would make the six-role judgment incomplete.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R1 Supply used one 2181-character reflection draft after two requests; the successor adds only the missing third route.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max research profile because this node must reason over newly returned evidence rather than merely format it.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One draft call, no retry; a truncated or missing tool draft fails and cannot be replaced by Harness-written analysis.

supply_followup_reflection_submission.node_purpose: Map the preserved Supply round-two reflection draft into the strict reflection submission contract.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.input_scale: One newly captured Supply reflection draft plus the exact second-round schema and authority enums.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.required_outputs: One valid model-owned reflection submission with locally bound round and schema identity.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.schema_burden: The final request catalog is exhausted and open gaps remain, so only the locally eligible stop state may be submitted.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.materiality_quality_risk: Changing the research conclusion or hiding a gap would corrupt the Supply workpaper and Lead input.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R1 showed that research drafts can be useful while JSON or graph predicates remain unsuitable for direct validation.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because no new financial reasoning is authorized in this step.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one tool call, no retry; any added authority, invalid reference or truncation fails closed.

specialist_workpaper_analysis.node_purpose: Produce full decision-ready workpaper drafts for Operating, Value, Cash and Supply from their validated dynamic research state.
specialist_workpaper_analysis.input_scale: Each role receives its compact but complete reviewed Evidence, numeric authorities, relations, gaps, reflections, method and graph context.
specialist_workpaper_analysis.required_outputs: Thesis, sourced claims, mechanism, alternatives, strongest counterarguments, WWC, remaining gaps and cross-role challenges.
specialist_workpaper_analysis.schema_burden: Workpapers contain several nested claim and challenge arrays and must preserve role boundaries and all reference authority.
specialist_workpaper_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: These are substantive financial research nodes; insufficient reasoning would produce a structurally valid but commercially weak report.
specialist_workpaper_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: The accepted DELL value-capture unit required a thinking research stage and later achieved 21 of 24 applicable quality points.
specialist_workpaper_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max research profile to prioritize mechanism, counterevidence and decision usefulness over speed or cost.
specialist_workpaper_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One draft per role, no retry; truncated drafts remain captured but cannot be promoted or locally completed.

specialist_workpaper_submission.node_purpose: Map Demand plus four new specialist drafts into strict model-owned Workpaper fields while Counterevidence reuses its valid capture locally.
specialist_workpaper_submission.input_scale: Each mapping sees one preserved draft, the compact validated context and exact reference-constrained submission schema.
specialist_workpaper_submission.required_outputs: One contract-valid workpaper preserving the draft thesis, claims, mechanisms, counterarguments, WWC and authority refs.
specialist_workpaper_submission.schema_burden: Large nested workpaper arrays and reference enums require a dedicated mapping call rather than a fragile one-shot research submission.
specialist_workpaper_submission.materiality_quality_risk: The mapper may not add or remove financial judgment; any reference or content drift blocks the role and Lead.
specialist_workpaper_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R1 Demand produced a 5593-character useful but invalid JSON workpaper while Counterevidence was valid except for local envelope metadata.
specialist_workpaper_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile to maximize strict contract fidelity and avoid re-reasoning the research draft.
specialist_workpaper_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one tool call per mapped role, no retry; invalid JSON, new refs or truncation fail closed.

lead_coordination_analysis.node_purpose: Compare all six valid specialist workpapers, identify material cross-role conflicts and route only justified repairs to their owners.
lead_coordination_analysis.input_scale: Six complete workpapers plus a deterministic challenge catalog; round two uses the authority-preserving repaired set when needed.
lead_coordination_analysis.required_outputs: Accepted challenge IDs, coordination rationale and a proceed, repair or data/tool pause routing judgment.
lead_coordination_analysis.schema_burden: Lead must choose only catalog-bound challenges and cannot invent facts, refs or an unowned research task.
lead_coordination_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: Weak synthesis can miss contradictions or over-repair sound roles, directly affecting the final multi-agent judgment.
lead_coordination_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: The zero-call multi-agent proof required one Lead challenge and one role-local repair before proceeding to evaluation.
lead_coordination_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max research profile because cross-role comparison and conflict materiality require substantive reasoning.
lead_coordination_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: At most two draft rounds, no retry; truncation or off-catalog routing fails and cannot be silently converted to proceed.

lead_coordination_submission.node_purpose: Map each preserved Lead draft into the strict catalog-bound coordination decision contract.
lead_coordination_submission.input_scale: One Lead draft and its exact deterministic challenge-ID schema per authorized Lead round.
lead_coordination_submission.required_outputs: One valid routing decision with locally bound Lead identity and schema version.
lead_coordination_submission.schema_burden: Accepted challenges must be a unique subset of the visible catalog and next state must remain internally consistent.
lead_coordination_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapping error could route an unapproved repair or falsely declare evaluation readiness.
lead_coordination_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R1 never reached Lead, while the zero-call proof established the exact challenge and repair topology used here.
lead_coordination_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because the research routing judgment already exists in the preserved Lead draft.
lead_coordination_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one submission per Lead round, no retry; invalid challenge IDs, state or truncation fail closed.

role_repair_analysis.node_purpose: Let at most three original specialist owners revise only the judgment surfaces challenged by the Lead.
role_repair_analysis.input_scale: One prior validated workpaper, role-local context and one or more catalog-bound cross-role FeedbackReceipts.
role_repair_analysis.required_outputs: A revised workpaper draft that answers accepted challenges without changing the underlying authority reference sets.
role_repair_analysis.schema_burden: The repair context locks Evidence, NumericFact, relation and gap authority while retaining the full workpaper structure.
role_repair_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: Repair must improve consistency without laundering a data/tool gap into a rewritten conclusion.
role_repair_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: The prior zero-call proof repaired one ValueCapture challenge while preserving all authority refs and passing Lead recheck.
role_repair_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max research profile because resolving a material cross-role challenge requires genuine financial reconsideration.
role_repair_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: At most three role drafts, no retry; any truncation, scope drift or authority change fails closed.

role_repair_submission.node_purpose: Map each preserved role-repair draft into the strict specialist Workpaper contract.
role_repair_submission.input_scale: One repair draft, the locked repair context and its exact authority-constrained schema.
role_repair_submission.required_outputs: One contract-valid repaired workpaper with exactly unchanged Evidence, numeric relation and gap authority sets.
role_repair_submission.schema_burden: Nested claims and challenges must remain valid while identity and schema metadata are bound locally.
role_repair_submission.materiality_quality_risk: Any authority-set change would allow a role to invent support while ostensibly responding to the Lead.
role_repair_submission.comparable_run_evidence: The current zero-call repair path proves authority-preserving validation and Lead recheck for one targeted role.
role_repair_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because this node must preserve the completed repair judgment.
role_repair_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one submission for each authorized repair, no retry; truncation or authority drift fails closed.

known_boundary: This exact-once authority continues only the failed R1 submission frontier. It reuses the immutable six prior S1/S2 rounds and research drafts, permits exactly one missing Supply request, and may create six valid specialist workpapers, at most two Lead rounds and no more than three authority-preserving role repairs. It forbids whole-chain rerun, external source acquisition, Candidate promotion, retry, fallback, current pointer mutation, Harness-written financial judgment, Writer execution, publication, S3 acceptance, generalization claims and release. Any failure consumes its attempt identity and remains immutable evidence for a separately justified disposition.
